paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with spin-based amplifiers
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (derivative axion-nucleon coupling, as reported by paper)
notes: Search for ALP dark matter (8.3-744 feV) using 129Xe-87Rb spin-based amplifier. Constrains ALP-nucleon coupling gaNN in GeV^-1 (via 129Xe, neutron-rich isotope -> AxionNeutron). Best 5h limit gaNN=2.9e-9 GeV^-1 at 67.5 feV; 100s data ~3.5e-9 GeV^-1 (e.g. 3.5e-9 at 82.05 feV). Values are the paper's derivative-coupling gaNN in GeV^-1, NOT the dimensionless g_an — downstream conversion needed. Paper also sets dark-photon (dEDM/dMDM) and quadratic ALP limits, but primary result is gaNN. Only sparse numerical values available from text; exclusion curve is approximately flat but degrades at high mass. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
